title: Active Directory
intro: Users of your Active Directory log in with their own account and password, which the directory checks. Their role comes from their groups: give a role to each group that may use BackROLL. Local users keep working, whatever happens to the directory.
enabled: Let the users of the Active Directory log in
serverUrlHint: ldaps://dc01.example.com:636. The password of the users crosses the network: use ldaps://, or ldap:// with StartTLS.
baseDnHint: Where the users and the groups are looked for, for example DC=example,DC=com.
bindDn: Account that looks for the users
bindDnHint: A read only account of the directory. It never logs anybody in. Give its distinguished name, or user{'@'}domain: in Active Directory the distinguished name holds the full name of the account (CN=Service BackROLL,...), not its login.
bindPasswordHint: Kept by BackROLL, never shown again.
userFilterHint: {'{'}username{'}'} is replaced by what the user typed. The default accepts the login name and the user{'@'}domain form.
verifyCertificate: Check the certificate of the directory
nestedGroups: Include the groups of the groups
caCertificate: Certificate of your certification authority (PEM), if the directory uses a private one
testOk: The directory answers, the account is accepted and the search base exists.
groupsHelp: The members of a group get its role. A user of several groups gets the highest role. A user in none of these groups can not log in.
noGroups: No group yet: nobody can log in with the directory.
addGroup: Give a role to this group
removeIntro: The members of {name} will not be able to log in any more with the directory, unless another group lets them.
lookupHelp: Shows what a user of the directory would get, without his password: where he is found, his groups of the list and his role.
lookupNotFound: This user is not in the directory (or several users have this name).
lookupDisabled: This account is disabled in the directory.
lookupNoRole: He is in none of the groups of the list: he could not log in.
unableLoad: Unable to read the settings of the directory
saved: The settings of the directory are saved.
unableLookup: Unable to look up the user
